claims.disproof_condition: 若後續 filing 顯示 CPO 合作終止、或 TSMC/FOCI 導入第二家 WLO 供應商，夥伴關係的獨占推論失效。
claims.statement: HIMX FY2025 20-F 一手證實：2024-06 與 FOCI（filing 稱其為 silicon photonics connector 世界領導者）合作發表 CPO 技術、leveraging Himax WLO——Hunterbrook 專利鏈推測的 FOCI×Himax 關係獲當事人揭露升級。另與『leading global customer and partner』推進多世代 CPO 架構（未具名，不推定身份）。

claims.disproof_condition: 若 HIMX 開始拆分揭露 WLO/光學分部營收且占比顯著（>10%），純度判斷需上修重評。
claims.statement: HIMX 純度驗證（四維度第 4 項）：WLO/CPO 營收未拆分揭露，主業為 display driver IC；客戶集中（前兩大 >33%、前十大 71.3%、customer A 24.0% 連三年降）屬 driver IC 客戶結構，不得誤讀為 CPO 綁定。$2.38B 市值、forward P/E 10.5、2 位分析師＝市場按週期 driver IC 定價、CPO 期權幾乎零入價。

source_doc.permission_basis: SEC EDGAR public filing; quotes only.
source_doc.title: Himax Technologies FY2025 Form 20-F (filed 2026-03-27)

sources.quote: In June 2024, Himax, in partnership with FOCI, a world leader in silicon photonics connector, unveiled an industry-leading co-packaged optics (CPO) technology, leveraging Himax WLO technology.

In addition, we are actively advancing multiple future generations of high-speed optical transmission technologies and advanced CPO architectures in collaboration with the leading global customer and partner to meet the explosive bandwidth demands of HPC and AI applications.
Our non-driver technologies cover Timing controller (TCON), LCoS microdisplay, CMOS image sensor, wafer level optics (“WLO”), 3D sensing and WiseEye ultralow power AI sensing, etc.
Our two largest customers together accounted for over 33% of our revenues in 2025.
ten largest customers together accounted for approximately 74.1%, 73.6% and 71.3% of our revenues in 2023, 2024 and 2025, respectively.
